title: Fix Coda Sidecar Startup Command
description: Re-implement the welcome screen (create/open project) on the current simplified main.ts (HTTP-based MCP, no sidecar). Must not spawn any sidecar process. Add dialog and project IPC handlers, preload bridges, and WelcomePage component.
summary: Fixed sidecar startup: changed SIDECAR_CMD from coda (non-existent binary) to uv with args run --active coda.py --sidecar. Set cwd to coda/engine/ resolved via app.getAppPath(). Used currentProjectPath instead of process.env.CODA_PROJECT in startSidecar(). Added sidecar.on error handler to prevent uncaught ENOENT crashes.
